name: Moongipa Capital Finance Limited
about: Moongipa Capital Finance Limited, a non-banking finance company, provides a suite of financing products in India. The company offers unsecured corporate and personal financing; retail loans; micro-finance; and electric vehicle (EV) financing, salary-linked credit, and personal and business loans. It also trades in securities. In addition, the company invests in shares of listed and unlisted companies and other securities. Moongipa Capital Finance Limited was incorporated in 1987 and is based in New Delhi, India.
